scope: AST-only correspondence between retained public Go declarations and stored historical root/component/digest metadata

calculation_policy.file_set: one FileSet with fixed files in declared order
calculation_policy.position_policy: physical PositionFor(false), zero-based start-inclusive/end-exclusive byte spans, inclusive one-based line bounds
calculation_policy.registry_binding: closed top-level sourceCatalog, state source-spec/run literals and flow source-spec/dispatch identifiers; syntax correspondence only
calculation_policy.declaration_node_policy: FuncDecl for function/method; TypeSpec for type; whole GenDecl for every value symbol including inherited const/iota positions
calculation_policy.method_identity: restricted receiver shape preserving the historical unqualified receiver symbol such as *identityCause.Error; no object binding or alias resolution
calculation_policy.formatted_digest: SHA256 of Go1.27.1 format.Node output over the original node
calculation_policy.normalization: scanner mode0; token decimal number + colon + literal + semicolon; IDENT except append,len,make,int,bool,true,false,nil becomes underscore
calculation_policy.bundle: canonical component-ID order: ID+NUL+formattedSHA+NUL, then package-wide sorted standard imports as std:path+NUL, exact suffix go1.27.1;standard-library-infrastructure-v1
calculation_policy.cache_policy: no cache: format each root and original component relation separately
calculation_policy.ordering: preserve original root and component relation positions; reject noncanonical component order instead of silently sorting altered descriptors
calculation_policy.shared_spans: distinct enum value IDs may share a whole GenDecl span; same-ID descriptors must agree across roots
calculation_policy.counter_completion: physical completed counts returned calls including error returns; ParsesSucceeded counts successful parses; file-pin and root/component completion follow expected digest agreement
calculation_policy.registry_entry_counter: aggregate registry cardinality recorded after successful registry extraction, not per-entry attempted/completed calls
calculation_policy.first_mismatch: stop and return an incomplete report with partial attempted/completed counters

future_runner_requirements: Freeze the exact compiled Go source closure, support files, current build recipe and code commit before original inventory calculations
Bind actual Go1.27.1 build info, platform, CGO0, trimpath, buildvcs=false and binary byte count/SHA rather than trusting the caller GoVersion string
Pin original raw files and metadata bytes plus input commit and canonical execution-plan bytes
Use bounded regular files, fixed repository-relative paths, exclusive fresh output and fixed safe error enums; preserve all partial counters on failure
Reserve output before inventory calculations; no automatic retry or host-global approval lock
Keep physical formatter/scanner/bundle calls separate from logical relations and distinct metadata IDs/digests
Predeclare exact CI report/counter replay; later frozen regression tests are post-observation support, not retroactive source/support pins
existing_ci_note: Existing repository regression and native model integration checks remain; their replays are not new60 source collection or model-performance experiments
resource_note: No runtime memory, CPU/GPU, latency or savings measurement has been made for this preparation. Work-count expectations are not speed claims.
preservation: Original 72 parents/216 candidate positions/21 unknowns/17 groups/16 groups containing known parents, captions, labels and stop reasons remain unchanged. No new15-repository condition or 2400-every-development-fit prerequisite; distinct2400-per-domain protected-final target remains separate.
